entities.name: Anna Vsevolodovna of Kyiv
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anna Vsevolodovna of Kiev, also called Yanka or Ianka, was a princess of Kievan Rus', known for having introduced schools for girls in Kievan Rus'. She is one of the six women mentioned by their full personal names in the Primary Chronicle (PVL).
